name: Automatic Backplane Placement Robot
summary: Used for automatically placing backplanes into product assembly stations, working with robots for precision assembly.
contentHtml:
The Automatic Backplane Placement Robot is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for the backplane placement process.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a robot with a precision positioning system to automatically grab and place backplanes into product assembly stations. It works collaboratively with assembly robots to achieve full automation of backplane installation.

Technical Advantages

  • Robotic automatic placement for high efficiency
  • Precise positioning ensuring assembly accuracy
  • High automation level, reducing manual intervention
  • Stable quality control for consistent product quality
